summary: First Guaranty Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events to announce a quarterly cash dividend on its 6.75% Series A Fixed-Rate Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock. On April 16, 2026, the Board declared a $16.875 per share preferred dividend ($0.421875 per Depositary Share) payable on June 1, 2026 to holders of record as of May 15, 2026. The Series A Preferred Stock dividend will be paid to the depositary, which will distribute to Depositary Share holders. No recommendation, advisor, premium, or change in corporate structure is noted. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation; the filing serves as public notice. Monitor for any suspension or rate change.
